rows.label: tlk70000071_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Going to stop Heaven's Holy Grail? No,
I'm not stopping you... I'm just angry
at how powerless I am.

rows.label: tlk70000071_05_msg0002
rows.name:
But you're different from me. Though
Drivers and Blades, I think you've had
more adventures than any adventurer.

rows.label: tlk70000071_05_msg0003
rows.name:
You have such strength, and you're
so pure in your pursuit... To tell
you the truth, I'm a little jealous.

rows.label: tlk70000071_05_msg0004
rows.name:
No, never mind. I think I'll go help
guide the evacuees!
